message.content:
This vertical-format editorial illustration is a magazine cover with a red left border and the large red title "TEMPO" at the top. Below the title, red handwritten text reads "50 Tah". In the top left, white text reads "MENTERI JOKOWI DI PANDORA PAPERS," and on the top right, "JALAN DI TEMPAT LEMBAGA INVESTASI," separated by a thin white diagonal line.

The central subject is a stylized illustration of a woman from the chest up, facing forward. She has black hair pulled back tightly and tan skin rendered with visible, blocky highlights and shadows in peach, orange, and blue tones. She wears a reddish-brown, patterned V-neck garment featuring yellow and blue leaf-like motifs. A white text box in the lower left reads "LAPORAN KHUSUS UMI SARDJONO DAN STIGMA GERWANI."

In the bottom right corner, white text indicates "4-10 OKTOBER 2021," a price of "RP 45.000," and website details above a QR code and barcode. The background is a textured beige and yellow surface with a painterly finish.
